_comment: Diagnostic scheme - INCOMPLETE, it produces no output. It ships `diagnostic-logmask` alone, which forces the trace mask gating `Log_msg` so the ~5900 sites that go through it run to completion; they then call 0x010346d0, the sink, which the vendor shipped as `li r3,0 ; blr`, so the message is discarded. builds/diagnostic-logging.json adds the sink half. Do not add `diagnostic-logging`: it repoints the same sink at `Log_msg`, so the two call each other. Do not drive on it.
